3. Cross-cutting governance notes

  • No owner decisions recorded: all items above remain in their preserved statuses; no decision is made, approved, deferred-by-owner, or closed by this register.
  • No implementation authorized: identification of a conditionally ready increment does not authorize implementation. I-00–I-14 classifications remain as documented in POSTGRESQL_ROUND3_READINESS_AND_BLOCKER_MATRIX.md and POSTGRESQL_ROUND3_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
  • Contradiction/source gap: absence of committed POSTGRESQL_SCHEMA_OPEN_DECISIONS.md and committed ADR 0006 markdown source at baseline is reported for owner review; this package does not infer or replace missing source content.
  • Invariants preserved: tenant isolation (trusted verified transaction-bound context only; no client-supplied tenant IDs; no user-settable PostgreSQL GUC authorization), authoritative binding/immutable source_device_key_id, ledger/event-dedup separation, typed lineage, no exactly-once external delivery, licensing/identity invariants, MELIRA external SaaS constraints.
